label: mm_add_order
condition: mm add[i] > mm add[i-1], list seeded with +0x50

label: spot_mm_add_order
condition: mm add[i] > mm add[i-1], list seeded with +0x60

label: ntl_order
condition: ntl[i-1] >= ntl[i] unsigned, list seeded with 0

label: extra_sum
condition: sum of +0x78 map values > 1.0, sum starts at -0.0

label: perp_floors
condition: 0x3c05c30 false for cross, add, mm add

label: spot_floors
condition: 0x3c05c30 false for spot cross, spot add, mm add

label: cross_negative
condition: 0.0 > x over cross then spot cross lists

label: cross_cap
condition: x > 0.001 over cross then spot cross lists

label: add_cap
condition: |x| > 0.001 over add, mm add, spot add, spot mm add lists
